sources.title: In Good GRACEs: Principled Teacher Selection for Knowledge Distillation
sources.snippet: We propose a lightweight score called GRACE to quantify how effective a teacher will be for post-training a student model. GRACE measures distributional properties of the student's gradients without access to a verifier, teacher logits, teacher internals, or test data.

sources.title: GRACE: Teacher Selection for Distillation
sources.snippet: The paper introduces GRACE, a novel metric using student gradients to select optimal teachers in knowledge distillation, enhancing model performance.

sources.snippet: 1 Introduction Distillation is an efficient and effective method to produce capable small models from existing, powerful teacher models. In this work, we focus on the specific case of training autoregressive language models on text generated by a teacher model.
